violation_type.title: AP Never exceed capacity of the home (26 TAC §747.207(10))
violation_type.short_title: AP Never exceed capacity of the home
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation was observed caring for thirteen children. The capacity on the permit is 12.

finding_variants.text: The operation was observed caring for thirteen children. The capacity on the permit is 12.
The operation exceeded the home capacity.

The operation is permitted to care for a max of 12 children. At the time of inspection 13 children were in care. The operation did send one child home to return to compliance after the violation was identified by the inspector.

Registered Child Care Home is exceeding capacity by providing care for 10 children ages: 0-17 months -2 infants; 18 months and older- 4 children and 5 years and older -4 children. NOTE: Minimum Standard 747.1701- Maximum number of children allowed in the chlid-care home at any one time is 8.
The operation had 13 children present at time of inspection. One child was sent home immediately bringing the operation back in to compliance.
There were 15 children in care between the ages of 7 months old to 3 years old.
